text:
Maya (Design): Quick sync: small A/B on required markers and error summary placement for the integrations form. Two choices: asterisk-only vs explicit '(required)'. Also deciding when to use typed-confirm for deleting an integration.
Omar (Product): Users confused by missing required labels on mobile. Lean explicit '(required)' on mobile, asterisk on desktop. Keep copy consistent.
Eve (Eng): Technically easy: render different label variants based on viewport. We'll add aria-required for inputs.
Claire (Accessibility): Asterisk alone is not accessible. Use aria-required plus either visible '(required)' or include hidden text for screen readers. Also summary must be focusable and announce on submit failure.
Ruth (DevEx): Microcopy: summary heading: "Please fix 1 error to continue" vs "Please fix 1 error to save". I prefer tying to the action: "to save" is clearer.
Maya (Design): OK "Please fix X errors to save". For inline errors, show on blur with aria-live=polite; on submit show summary with assertive.
Omar (Product): Typed-confirm for deletes: medium risk -> checkbox + count, high risk -> typed-confirm. For integrations, any external data delete = high risk? Probably typed-confirm if it revokes keys.
Eve (Eng): Dev note: typed-confirm default case-insensitive. Add allowExactMatch flag for exceptions. Also add cooldownMs after 4 failed attempts.
Claire (Accessibility): Ensure typed-confirm instructions are in aria-describedby and that Esc clears the input. Also make cancel the first tabbable control.
bot-deploy: FYI: experiments flagged in analytics: validation.required_label_A/B.
Maya (Design): I'll push a tiny prototype and update the design patterns doc. Review by tomorrow morning?
Omar (Product): I'll do copy pass.
Ruth (DevEx): I'll run keyboard checklist once prototype is up.
Eve (Eng): I'll estimate and add props for implementation.
